svg.text: B13 / Back of the Spice Street shops
The service-yard enclosure uses three high blind panels and a stained base, with no public access on this side.
Source shells / roofs; rust = design extent, not a live transform.
Retain the measured shell and source roof silhouette. Public bays
follow this card; useful supported return/service evidence
remains. No new route, upper floor or repeated extra niche. Read
the district response schedule for this owner and close
